LESSON: TAKING AWAY

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.9: Taking away

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Taking away. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. count objects in different sets to than 9. establish the number in each set • Few learners demonstrate taking
2. count the number of the • In pairs, groups and individually remaining objects after taking

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: TAKING AWAY
Taking away is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Taking away problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Taking away question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Taking away question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Taking away set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Taking away.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Taking away in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. count objects in different sets to than 9. establish the number in each set • Few learners demonstrate taking
2. count the number of the • In pairs, groups and individually remaining objects after taking

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
